reason: Last time I paid and the staff never touched it, but here the second ₹5,000 only gets paid if my stylists actually bill in it for 20 days, and someone comes and trains them in Odia. ₹500 a month is nothing for my salon, so the real risk is only the first ₹5,000 and some disruption, and I can live with that.
objection: My stylists are busy with customers; on a rush Saturday they will skip the app and take cash, and then I am back to the register. Also I am not keen on showing my salon setup to nearby competing owners.
would_change_my_mind: If in the first two weeks the stylists keep skipping billing and the support person does not actually come back to fix it, I would stop and want my money back.
